title: Art Director - Mexico
text: The Marketing team in Latin America defines and evolves how Spotify shows up across the region. We shape brand experiences that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply rooted in music culture. In Mexico, our work connects artists, fans, and communities through bold storytelling and culturally fluent creative execution. The Art Director plays a critical role in defining and driving Spotify’s brand in the region. Working across disciplines, the Art Director ensures Spotify shows up in ways that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply connected to music culture. While focused on Mexico, the role sits within the broader Latin American organization and may contribute to regional projects where local creative leadership is required.
